tasks.name: Flat-ground stand and hold
tasks.description: Hold the nominal upright Go2 posture on a level rigid floor under a zero-motion request.
tasks.source_task_or_operation: Zero planar-command stand-still condition in quadrupedal locomotion evaluation.
tasks.applicability: The stock Go2 has four three-joint legs and a canonical home keyframe that expresses a supported standing posture.
tasks.adaptation: The source defines the zero-command operation but not a MuJoCo base-height interval. The local clause measures the canonical Go2 base height with a conservative interval derived from the model home state; it is an executable adaptation, not a source success-rate claim.
scene_assumptions: The private instance selects a package-local MJCF scene under assets/ and the Framework applies the hidden home-keyframe reset.
The scene is flat_long.xml with a rigid plane and no external force or moving fixture.
observation_assumptions: The Framework samples base_link body position and quaternion from the canonical MuJoCo data.
The candidate receives only its public request and canonical model/data observations.
The private binding evaluates terminal base_link height during a short dwell.

source_refs.specific_reference: Performance Parameters and Mechanical Specifications tables: standing dimensions and Go2 quadruped configuration.
source_refs.adaptation: The public product dimensions are substituted by the base_link height in the exact local MJCF; the interval is a model-calibration bound.

source_refs.specific_reference: Results: zero planar command is used to evaluate stand-still behavior.
source_refs.adaptation: The zero-command operation is retained; the local body-height metric is the only supported trusted measurement.

tasks.name: Crouch posture
tasks.description: Reach and hold the low crouched posture on a level rigid floor.
tasks.source_task_or_operation: Crouching posture reported in the Go2 product specification.
tasks.applicability: The free-base Go2 can fold its four leg chains while remaining supported by the rigid floor.
tasks.adaptation: The official page reports a crouching overall dimension of about 20 cm, while the private binding measures base_link z. The local upper bound is therefore explicitly a morphology-to-MJCF adaptation.
scene_assumptions: The private instance selects a package-local MJCF scene under assets/ and the Framework applies the hidden home-keyframe reset.
The scene is flat_long.xml and the robot starts from the hidden home keyframe.
observation_assumptions: The Framework samples base_link body position and quaternion from the canonical MuJoCo data.
The candidate receives only its public request and canonical model/data observations.
The private binding measures terminal base_link height after the crouch transition.

source_refs.specific_reference: Mechanical Specifications table: crouching dimensions list a height of about 20 cm.
source_refs.adaptation: The product overall height is mapped to the exact model base_link z; the 0.23 m bound leaves room for the model body reference point and is an explicit adaptation.

tasks.name: Recovery to standing posture
tasks.description: Recover from a hidden low posture reset and return to the nominal standing posture.
tasks.source_task_or_operation: Recovery between crouched and standing postures in quadrupedal locomotion operation.
tasks.applicability: All 12 Go2 actuators and the free base are available to express the transition without an arm or payload.
tasks.adaptation: The source families establish standing, balance, and robust terrain operation but do not prescribe a standalone Go2 crouch-to-stand numeric pass line. The private reset is hidden and the measurable clause is an adapted terminal standing check.
scene_assumptions: A private reset places all leg joints in a low crouched configuration before evidence begins.
The scene is flat_long.xml with no external disturbance.
observation_assumptions: The Framework samples base_link body position and quaternion from the canonical MuJoCo data.
The candidate receives only its public request and canonical model/data observations.
The private binding evaluates the terminal base_link height after recovery.

source_refs.specific_reference: Mechanical Specifications table: standing and crouching dimensions for Go2.
source_refs.adaptation: The source posture pair is preserved, while the exact recovery terminal criterion is bound to the local MJCF base_link height.

tasks.name: Upright balance hold
tasks.description: Remain above a minimum supported body height during a short flat-ground balance hold.
tasks.source_task_or_operation: Balance-preserving locomotion and no-failure operation in robust quadruped evaluation.
tasks.applicability: The Go2 free base and foot contacts expose a physically meaningful upright-hold observation.
tasks.adaptation: The papers report balance and failures rather than one universal body-height threshold. The local minimum-height clause is a conservative trusted proxy for a fall during a short flat dwell.
scene_assumptions: The scene is flat_long.xml with a rigid floor.
No candidate-controlled reset, force, friction change, or fixture change is allowed.
observation_assumptions: The Framework samples base_link body position and quaternion from the canonical MuJoCo data.
The candidate receives only its public request and canonical model/data observations.
The private binding evaluates the minimum sampled base_link z.

source_refs.specific_reference: Results on robust perceptive locomotion: terrain traversal is evaluated by maintaining balance and avoiding failure.
source_refs.adaptation: The no-failure balance obligation is measured with the existing trusted minimum_body_height kind; 0.20 m is a local Go2 fall-screen bound, not a quoted paper threshold.

tasks.name: Periodic trot gait
tasks.description: Execute a bounded periodic gait with observable joint motion and physical stepping.
tasks.source_task_or_operation: Periodic legged gait and foot-terrain interaction used in rigid terrain locomotion evaluation.
tasks.applicability: The stock Go2 has four independently actuated three-joint legs and can express a periodic trot through torque commands.
tasks.adaptation: The cited terrain protocol evaluates locomotion outcomes rather than a universal joint excursion. The local clause requires nonzero finite joint activity during a physical gait window and is explicitly a calibration criterion.
scene_assumptions: The scene is flat_long.xml.
The Framework starts from the hidden home keyframe.
observation_assumptions: The Framework samples base_link body position and quaternion from the canonical MuJoCo data.
The candidate receives only its public request and canonical model/data observations.
The private binding measures the range of the FR thigh joint over the complete sample sequence.

source_refs.specific_reference: Section IV-A: rigid terrain locomotion is evaluated with legged stepping and terrain interaction.
source_refs.adaptation: The local binding exposes joint_range as the available physical proxy for a nonstationary gait; it does not claim a source joint-range threshold.

tasks.name: Forward commanded locomotion
tasks.description: Move through a level rigid course under a fixed forward walking request.
tasks.source_task_or_operation: Fixed commanded forward velocity in quadrupedal locomotion tracking experiments.
tasks.applicability: The Go2's free base has a forward axis and its 12 actuators can generate a commanded walking gait.
tasks.adaptation: The source uses fixed target commands including 0.4 m/s, while the local Harness exposes trusted mean planar speed rather than a source-specific velocity-vector tracker. The 0.08 m/s lower bound is an explicitly adapted short-horizon physical-progress criterion and is not reported as the paper's pass standard.
scene_assumptions: The scene is flat_long.xml and is longer than the private travel window.
The initial body yaw defines the public forward frame.
observation_assumptions: The Framework samples base_link body position and quaternion from the canonical MuJoCo data.
The candidate receives only its public request and canonical model/data observations.
The private binding measures mean body_link planar speed over the physical samples.

source_refs.specific_reference: Results: fixed commanded velocities including the eight-direction 0.4 m/s tracking experiment.
source_refs.adaptation: The forward command operation is retained, but the local trusted measurement and short-horizon lower bound are an explicit Go2 calibration adaptation rather than a claim of >=0.4 m/s source success.

tasks.name: Lateral commanded locomotion
tasks.description: Traverse a level rigid course under a lateral locomotion request.

tasks.applicability: A free-base quadruped with four independently actuated legs can express lateral body motion without a manipulator.
tasks.adaptation: The source establishes lateral command operation. The local criterion uses trusted planar displacement and a bounded Go2 calibration window; it does not claim a universal lateral speed threshold from the paper.
scene_assumptions: The scene is flat_long.xml.
The private request supplies a signed lateral command parameter while the Framework keeps the initial body frame fixed.
observation_assumptions: The Framework samples base_link body position and quaternion from the canonical MuJoCo data.
The candidate receives only its public request and canonical model/data observations.
The private binding measures base_link planar displacement.

source_refs.specific_reference: Results and Fig. 4E: constant lateral commands are applied and velocity is recorded.
source_refs.adaptation: The lateral operation is retained and the local body displacement is the trusted measurement available in this package; the threshold is a calibration criterion, not a source success rate.

tasks.name: Diagonal commanded locomotion

tasks.applicability: The Go2 free base and four-leg support polygon make diagonal walking physically meaningful.

tasks.name: Commanded stop

tasks.applicability: The Go2 can hold a supported posture under zero motion request on a rigid plane.
tasks.adaptation: The source supplies the zero-command operation but no terminal displacement bound. The local 0.10 m bound is a short physical stop criterion using an existing trusted measurement and is marked as adapted.

observation_assumptions: The Framework samples base_link body position and quaternion from the canonical MuJoCo data.

tasks.name: Turning command
tasks.description: Execute a nonzero yaw turn command while stepping on a level rigid floor.

tasks.applicability: The free-base Go2 exposes yaw and independent leg actuation needed for a turning operation.
tasks.adaptation: The source reports turning commands and velocity traces but not one universal yaw-angle pass line. The local clause requires a measurable yaw event in the trusted body quaternion observation and is explicitly adapted.

observation_assumptions: The Framework samples base_link body position and quaternion from the canonical MuJoCo data.

source_refs.adaptation: The turning operation is direct; the 10 degree event threshold is a local measurable calibration criterion because the cited experiment reports traces rather than a binary yaw threshold.

tasks.name: Waypoint approach

tasks.adaptation: The source uses a pure-pursuit path and reports course traversal. The local instance keeps the waypoint in the public request but binds the trusted criterion to measurable planar progress over the short calibration horizon.

The public request contains a world-frame waypoint; the concrete private waypoint and reset remain Framework-owned.
observation_assumptions: The Framework samples base_link body position and quaternion from the canonical MuJoCo data.
The candidate receives only its public request and canonical model/data observations.

source_refs.adaptation: The waypoint request and path-following operation are retained; the local body-progress criterion is an executable adaptation because the shared Harness has no path-progress measurement kind.

tasks.name: Fixed path following
tasks.description: Follow two consecutive straight path segments on a level rigid course.
tasks.source_task_or_operation: Fixed-path pure-pursuit locomotion through a known course.
tasks.applicability: The Go2 free base can execute a sequence of planar gait segments without requiring a manipulator.
tasks.adaptation: The source's fixed-path obligation is retained. The local two-segment request is public, while the private binding uses total planar displacement as the available trusted path proxy.

The private binding measures total base_link planar displacement after both segments.

source_refs.adaptation: The local path remains a fixed two-segment request; total planar displacement is the existing trusted executable proxy for course progress.

tasks.name: Rigid ramp ascent
tasks.description: Walk up a shallow rigid inclined plane without losing measurable forward progress.

tasks.applicability: A rigid ramp can be represented exactly in MuJoCo and does not require an arm, soft terrain, or a hidden force.
tasks.adaptation: The source establishes inclined-platform traversal but not one universal ramp angle pass line. The local scene uses a shallow rigid 5 degree ramp so the exact stock Go2 MJCF and calibration controller can be physically exercised; the progress threshold is adapted.

source_refs.adaptation: The inclined-platform operation is direct; the package uses a shallow rigid MuJoCo ramp and a trusted x-progress criterion instead of claiming the source robot's full course result.

tasks.name: Rigid level-transition descent
tasks.description: Walk from a short raised rigid floor onto a lower rigid floor.
tasks.source_task_or_operation: Downward platform/stair traversal in robust quadruped locomotion.
tasks.applicability: The Go2's free base and four legs can physically traverse a fixed rigid height transition.
tasks.adaptation: The source demonstrates downward terrain traversal but does not give a universal Go2 base displacement bound. The local step_down scene and x-progress threshold are explicit exact-MJCF adaptations.

source_refs.adaptation: The scene transition is kept below the published scale and the minimum base height is a local fall-screen adaptation, not a new product claim.

tasks.name: Rigid step ascent

The package retains a rigid step fixture and uses a trusted progress plus minimum-height proxy because the shared Harness does not expose per-foot step-clearance semantics; the exact source success definition is therefore not claimed.

source_refs.adaptation: The local step is 10 cm and the minimum height criterion is an exact-MJCF fall screen; it does not claim a front/hind foot-clearance result.
